instruction: A lean single-seat hoverbike with no wheels, its carbon-black fairing slashed by hot-pink light strips and taped-on decal glyphs. Twin ducted thrust pods hang beneath a forward-canted frame, trailing exposed cable looms and a bolted-on scavenged armor plate. A holographic instrument sliver floats above the handlebars in acid green.
